original_test_intent: Verify each approved CX7 adapter's PCI vendor/device/subsystem identity and its PCIe capability, negotiated speed/width and effective lane bandwidth against the project specification.
original_method: Securely collect complete PCI inventory and full verbose configuration for every explicitly mapped CX7 BDF, then compare identity, LinkCap, LinkCap2, LnkSta, calculated bandwidth and AER state field by field.
manual_activity: User provides the target-device and PCIe specification matrix and reviews the generated comparison; no physical or GUI action is required.
required_inputs: Every target CX7 BDF plus serial/PSID mapping
Expected vendor/device/subsystem IDs and PCIe generation/width/bandwidth
pciutils/lspci with permission to read PCI configuration
Protected evidence location and optional MFT/ethtool/IB identity corroboration
safety_requirements: Use managed authentication and verify the host and stable device mapping
Keep all operations read-only; do not reset, remove, rescan or write PCI configuration
Preserve complete inventory and per-BDF output without head/grep-only loss
Stop on missing target, permission/tool error, AER/link contradiction or wrong-host evidence
Protect hardware identifiers and raw logs
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate full PCI inventory and resolve all approved BDFs
Collect full per-target PCIe capabilities, negotiated status and AER evidence
Calculate/report expected-versus-observed speed, width and bandwidth
Do not select the first match, modify PCI/device/link state or issue the engineer verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative target and specification matrix
Resolve any unexpected bifurcation, downgrade or unsupported-link condition

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually applicable but incomplete and unsafe because it uses bypassed SSH, first-match selection and head-truncated verbose output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect lspci -Dnn for the full inventory and untruncated lspci -Dvvv -s <BDF> for each approved CX7, then parse identity, LinkCap/LnkCap2/LnkSta and AER without changing device state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CX7 vendor/device ID, speed, bandwidth, SPEC comparison and 10/10 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use stable per-device mapping and complete PCI capability/status evidence to generate an auditable spec matrix for all CX7 functions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds subsystem/PSID correlation, every-device coverage, explicit negotiated-width/bandwidth and AER checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No PCIe information is dropped through filtering or truncation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Virtualization or restricted config-space access may hide extended capabilities; such output is incomplete, not a passing observation.

project_override_considerations: Expected generation and width must account for the approved slot/riser bifurcation and platform topology; nominal device capability must not be confused with negotiated status.
expected_evidence: Full LinkCap/LinkCap2/LnkSta speed/width and bandwidth calculation
AER/link-error fields and optional MFT/ethtool/IB corroboration
Field comparison, raw-output checksums, exit status and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 all identify read-only PCIe inspection; the latter corrects unsafe selection and evidence gaps without changing scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is automatable when normal host, mapping and specification inputs are supplied.

review_improvement: Prevents a first-device, truncated PCI snapshot from falsely representing every CX7 and makes capability-versus-negotiated state explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe LinkCap describes what an endpoint or port can support, while LnkSta describes the link actually negotiated; validating only one or the other can miss a lane-width or generation downgrade. Stable BDF-to-serial/PSID mapping is also necessary because multiple identical CX7 functions cannot be distinguished by vendor text alone.
